prompt: A worker will submit a bus-pass claim on Saturday. On Wednesday she drove to the satellite office and did not use her pass. What can she do?
promptZh: 一名員工打算星期六送出公車月票補助申請。星期三她開車到分部，當天沒用月票。她可以怎麼做？

options.text: Include both expenses in one request to receive both in this month’s pay.
options.zh: 把兩項費用併在一份申請，讓兩筆都在本月薪資入帳。
options.whyZh: 月票申請已過星期五，且兩項申請必須分開。

options.text: Expect the pass reimbursement next month and request a parking voucher separately for Wednesday.
options.zh: 等下個月領月票補助，並另外申請星期三的停車券。
options.whyZh: 月票申請晚於截止日；星期三未使用月票，可另申請當天停車券。

options.text: Expect the pass reimbursement next month but give up the parking voucher because her pass covered Wednesday.
options.zh: 下個月領月票補助，但月票星期三有效，不能申請停車券。
options.whyZh: 月票有效不等於當天使用；實際未使用就不排除星期三的停車券。

options.text: Request the Wednesday parking voucher separately and expect the Saturday pass claim in this month’s pay.
options.zh: 另外申請星期三的停車券，並等星期六的月票申請在本月薪資入帳。
options.whyZh: 停車處理正確，但星期六的月票申請要下個月才入帳。

evidence: Later claims will go into next month's pay. | You can still claim parking on a day you drove instead, provided you did not travel on the pass that day. | Keep the two requests separate.
explanationZh: 月票申請晚於截止日；星期三未使用月票，可另申請當天停車券。
difficultyRationale: Integrate cutoff, actual vs covered usage, and separate workflow. Two near-miss answers satisfy one branch.

vocabulary.term: provided you did not travel on the pass
vocabulary.zh: 前提是你當天沒有用該票搭車
vocabulary.note: provided 表示條件；持有涵蓋當天的票和當天實際用票不同。
